meta.name: browser
meta.description: Drives a real browser through the omowright library from the js eval kernel: sites the user is already signed into, forms and clicks, JS-rendered pages, screenshots, web QA, extension popups, a human handoff for login, CAPTCHA or OTP, and a browser you own for scraping, bot-scored targets, network capture and QA traces. Use for any interactive browser task; not for a plain search or an unblocked static fetch.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操作真实浏览器,完成点击、填表、截图与页面检查
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常需要让程序替你在真实网站上点击、填表或采集数据。
copy.tagline_en: Automate a real browser to click, fill forms, and capture screenshots
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need a program to click, fill forms, or scrape real websites.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会用 omowright 库驱动一个真实浏览器:在你已登录的网站上导航、填表、点击、截图、做网页 QA;遇到登录、验证码或 OTP 时可请你人工接手。
howto.when: 当你需要交互式浏览器操作时触发,比如填表点击、JS 渲染页面、截图或网页 QA;普通的搜索和未被拦截的静态抓取不走它。

say.text: 用我的浏览器打开 https://example.com 并截图给我
say.note: 在后台打开并返回截图

say.text: 帮我在这个页面上填好表单然后点提交
say.note: 需要你已在该网站登录

say.text: 这个页面要登录,让我来接手一下
say.note: 会弹出请求,由你手动完成

howto.what_en: Claude drives a real browser through the omowright library: navigating sites you're already signed into, filling forms and clicking, screenshots, web QA, and a human handoff for login, CAPTCHA or OTP.
howto.when_en: Triggers on any interactive browser task — forms, clicks, JS-rendered pages, screenshots, QA — not for a plain search or an unblocked static fetch.

say_en.text: Open https://example.com in my browser and screenshot it
say_en.note: Opens in background, returns a screenshot

say_en.text: Fill in the form on this page and click submit
say_en.note: Requires you to be signed in there

say_en.text: This page needs a login — let me handle it
say_en.note: Asks you to complete it by hand
